content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the lack of explicit specification of Locale when parsing and formatting milliseconds in the DateField class. This led to inconsistent behavior when handling date and time representations, particularly in relation to the expected canonical format. The patch addresses this by ensuring that Locale.US and UTC TimeZone are explicitly used, which clarifies the intended behavior and prevents potential issues arising from default Locale settings that could vary based on the environment.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: final DateMathParser p = new DateMathParser(UTC, Locale.US);
